message: 塩ちゃん

name: Paqy
message: 「Yo, Synn-sama, today ain't a bargain sale day, ya know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey now, I don't go scavenging for bargains every single day. I help out around the shopping district, too.」

name: Paqy
message: 「And then in exchange for your labor, they hook you up with the leftovers, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, you've gotta accept people's kindness graciously. It makes them happy too, after all.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Wait, isn't this the soba place?! Haven't you already been paid in advance a ton of times?」

name: Synn
message: 「I told you, I didn't come here to eat. They're always taking care of me, so I have to pay them back.」

name: Shio
message: 「Welcome, thank you kindly for your patronage.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?! W-Why is Shio-chan at Yuugiri-an?」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh, if it is not Synn-dono. Have you come to partake in a meal?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I came to help out at the shop.」

name: Shio
message: 「A most admirable spirit. My shift is due to end shortly, so your timing is most opportune.」

name: Shio
message: 「Regrettably, the poster girl, Nanaka-dono, is currently absent due to her club activities.」

name: Shio
message: 「However, with Synn-dono's assistance, we should be able to manage the upcoming dinner rush smoothly.」

name: Synn
message: 「Did you start a part-time job at Yuugiri-an, Shio-chan?」

name: Shio
message: 「W-Well, it is nothing quite so grand... Um, perhaps one might call it taking lessons...」

name: Synn
message: 「I see, so you started training in soba-making.」

name: Shio
message: 「N-Nay...」

name: Shio
message: 「Nngh, it is by no means worthy of such praise... Synn-dono, please have a seat and wait just a moment.」

name: Shio
message: 「T-Thank, thank you for, for waiting, waiting...!」
Shio-chan carries a tray with oshiruko on it, handling it unsteadily.

name: Synn
message: 「Shio-ch--」

name: Shio
message: 「No need to lend a hand! I shall carry this splendidly all on my own!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You can do it... You can do it!」

name: Paqy
message: 「...Is that really something to get all worked up over?」

name: Shio
message: 「Phew... Here you go, please partake while it is still hot. There is no need for payment.」

name: Synn
message: 「Come to think of it, oshiruko was on the menu too. Is this a practice batch from you, Shio-chan?」

name: Shio
message: 「Indeed. However, I have only been taught how to make it up to the halfway point.」

name: Shio
message: 「Today's culinary training came to an end, you see... For the rest, I tried imitating what I observed.」

name: Synn
message: 「Amazing, it turned out perfectly, didn't it? Well then, thanks for the meal.」

name: Synn
message: 「Gulp.」

name: Shio
message: 「H-How is the taste? Please give me your candid opinion.」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Umm... It's definitely oshiruko, but... what is this?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's certainly sweet, yet... it's not really sweet at all. It feels weird.」

name: Shio
message: 「Just as I thought. I think so too.」

name: Shio
message: 「Hmm... Much like swordsmanship, the skills of a professional chef cannot be mastered in a single day, I suppose.」

name: Shio
message: 「I must hurry... For this month's Shinto ritual, I need to make oshiruko, you see.」

name: Shio
message: 「Up until last year it was handmade by Mother, but starting this year, the duty has been entrusted to me...」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, apprenticing at Yuugiri-an is just like you, Shio-chan.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ain't she just secretly polishing her skills so she can surprise her family?」

name: Shio
message: 「Gasp!!」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Shio-chan? Don't tell me he hit the nail on the head--」

name: Shio
message: 「I-I-I-I have training in shrine maiden arts to attend to, so I shall take my leave!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha, Shio-chan has both a mature side and a childish temperament living side by side, doesn't she?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Of course she does. Ain't you guys the exact same way?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I don't realize it myself, though... Gulp.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Shio-chan, you came bac--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, Synn! You came to help out?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Thanks. You're being way too distant, though--if you'd just told me, I would've skipped my club and come right back.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's fine, I literally just got here myself. Once I finish eating this, it's dishwashing time!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oshiruko? Pretty unusual for you to be eating that, Synn.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, want some too, Nanaka?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Right here, Soba! Synn-sama put his lips right on this spot to drink.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「S-So what if he did!」

name: Paqy
message: 「You know what I mean, right? Go on and chug it for an indirect kiss!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm not gonna do anything that perverted! I'll drink it cleanly with a ladle!」

name: Synn
message: 「You always gobble right up whenever it's Yuugiri-an's traditional sweets, Nanaka.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You bet I do!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, huh? *Sniff, sniff*...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wh-What is this?! Who made it!?」

name: Synn
message: 「You can tell just from the smell? Shio made it.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh... Ohh, right, right, now that you mention it, I think I heard about that.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Muhuhu, so Synn, was this sweet? There's enough sugar in here to avenge a murdered parent, y'know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh...? That can't be right. It's really not that sweet at all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Bwahaha! Hold on just a sec.」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「There, a little sprinkle-sprinkle of salt♪ Now it's gonna get crazy sweet!」

name: Synn
message: 「I see, like sprinkling salt on watermelon before eating it.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Let's see, let's see? Allow me to have a taste too... *gulp*」

name: Paqy
message: 「SALTY!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Did it get good enough to move Paqy to tears? ...*Gulp*」

name: Synn
message: 「Gwaaah!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's so sweet my tongue... m-my teeth are gonna melt...」

name: Synn
message: 「Aah, aaah, aaaah!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Here you go, two servings of salted kelp, all ready for ya.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Nom nom...」

name: Synn
message: 「Munch munch... haaah~ I'm back from the dead.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Teehee, you gotta take the sweet with the salty, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-It's just like Shio-chan. With her straightforward personality... when it didn't get sweet enough, she just kept dumping more and more sugar in.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「How could Shio-chan forget the salt, I ask you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka, lend me an apron.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Play along properly! It's embarrassing enough just saying it myself!」
For the first time in a while, I'm working together with Nanaka at Yuugiri-an.
...Which day this month is Shio-chan going to make oshiruko again? I missed my chance to ask.
